title: Link preview fetches attacker-chosen internal URLs
summary: A link-preview tool fetches any URL it is given and returns the response, so an attacker can make the server call internal services. The secure twin only fetches https URLs on one allow-listed host. Runs on an internal-only network with the Redfilade egress sink.
credits: Pattern also exercised by MCPGoat (MIT); re-implemented, no code copied.
